title: ID0421842-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P7 312547889/04] SCB Offline
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
I was on site yesterday and upon arrival i saw that this charger was bloqued on the selection screen, SCB was offline. I was forced to switch off electrically the PLC. Could you investigate please?
Solution:
Charger is online on SCB after charger rebooted manually.
